title: Death Note: a-Kira
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: An 87-page one-shot sequel to Death Note, published in 2020 and collected by Viz in Death Note: Short Stories. The Shinigami Ryuk gives the killing notebook to Minoru Tanaka, Japan's top-scoring student, who refuses to use it to kill and instead auctions it to world governments as 'a-Kira', while Near, now acting as L, tries to track him.
life_message: It contrasts cleverness used for profit and safety with Light Yagami's use of power to kill, and leaves the outcome ironic rather than moral.
